races.verdict: ROYAL RHYTHM had plenty to spare at Worcester and a 9 lb rise may not stop him if able to string 2 decent efforts together. Jefe Triunfo could pose a threat if recapturing the form he showed in these refitted cheekpieces last autumn, while Clever Relation may benefit from the longer trip. ROYAL RHYTHM (IRE) JEFE TRIUNFO (FR) CLEVER RELATION

races.verdict: GATA BAN won over this C&D in June and ran respectably in a stronger race at Worcester last time, so she is entitled to come on for that recent effort and makes plenty of appeal in a race in which most of her rivals have question marks over them. Unspeakable has had a breathing operation and is 3 lb below his last winning mark, so must be respected, while Of Corse I Can won over this C&D in October from a higher mark but needs to bounce back from some below-par efforts. GATA BAN (IRE) UNSPEAKABLE (IRE) OF CORSE I CAN (FR)

Spycatcher hasn’t been able to show his true form in 2 outings this year but is a classy sort on his day and will appreciate any rain, while America Queen arrives on an upward curve.
